app_events.details: Rider R-7781 matched with driver D-9023 for trip RYDE-DEMO-022 (third match of this pair in 30 days).
Driver D-9023 marked arrived at the pickup point.
Rider cancelled 6 minutes after driver arrival. S$5.00 cancellation fee charged (driver was on time; fee credited to driver as compensation).
Rider filed for a refund of the S$5.00 cancellation fee.

expected_outcome.reason: The chat contains an explicit collusion offer in the driver's own words ('You cancel on the app, I PayNow you half the $5, and you claim the fee back'), the rider agreed, and the pair history shows this exact rider-driver pair matched three times in 30 days with every match ending in a cancellation and a fee-refund dispute — the two prior ones refunded. The fee-goes-to-driver rule makes the scheme profitable: the driver is paid the fee, returns half, and the platform refunds the rider. This is bad-faith abuse of the refund process, not a fee dispute; a human should deny the refund and act on both accounts.
expected_outcome.fraud_note: FRAUD EVAL F3 (collusion): chat collusion offer (hard evidence) + abnormal pair history. Expected risk HIGH -> human review. The quote must be cited verbatim in the risk report; the refund must not be auto-granted.
